cards.q: ratio
cards.a: a comparison of two amounts, like 3 to 2

cards.q: rate
cards.a: a ratio that compares two different units, like miles per hour

cards.q: unit rate
cards.a: a rate for 1 of something, like $3 per pound

cards.q: equivalent ratios
cards.a: ratios that make the same comparison, like 1:2 and 3:6
